heading: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Get quick answers to common questions about booking, amenities, and more. For additional inquiries, our team is here to assist you.

faqItems.question: What is the check-in and check-out time?
faqItems.answer: Check-in is from 3:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. If you need a different time, please contact us in advance, and we will do our best to accommodate your request.

faqItems.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we provide airport transfers. Please inform us of your flight details at least 48 hours before your arrival so we can arrange transportation for you.

faqItems.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqItems.answer: Breakfast is included in most of our packages. Please check the specific package details for more information.

faqItems.question: Are pets allowed in the villa?
faqItems.answer: We love animals, but we do not allow pets in the villa to ensure comfort and cleanliness for all our guests.

faqItems.question: What amenities are included in the villa?
faqItems.answer: Our villa includes air-conditioned bedrooms, a private pool, a fully equipped kitchen, Wi-Fi, and access to spa services and yoga classes.

faqItems.question: Do you provide Wi-Fi access?
faqItems.answer: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available throughout the villa.

faqItems.question: Can I cancel or modify my reservation?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we offer flexible cancellation policies. Please refer to our booking terms or contact us directly for more information on modifications or cancellations.

faqItems.question: Are there any additional charges for using the spa or other services?
faqItems.answer: Spa services and certain activities may incur additional charges. Please check the details of your package or contact us for more information.

faqItems.question: What is your policy on smoking?
faqItems.answer: Smoking is not permitted inside the villa. We provide designated outdoor areas where smoking is allowed.

faqItems.question: What safety measures are in place at the villa?
faqItems.answer: We prioritize your safety with 24/7 security, daily housekeeping, and adherence to health and safety guidelines. If you have any specific concerns, please let us know.

faqItems.question: Are there any nearby attractions or activities?
faqItems.answer: Yes, our villa is close to temples, waterfalls, beaches, and markets. We also offer guided tours and activities. Please ask us for recommendations.
